messages:
Sara P: Quick sync — need final alignment on private-offer calendar for the appliance bundle + marketplace listing. Partners: Nimbus HW + Azure Marketplace. High-level asks: SKU mapping, entitlement windows, announcement timing, and renewal overlap rules.

Miguel R: On it. Reminder: customers usually expect ~30d notice before commit/sku swaps. Let's avoid overlapping renewal promos that create churn.

Anjali K: Product preference: 2-week early-bird commit window, then 90d billing start. Also want a clear opt-in flow for appliance discounts. Any Nimbus constraints?

Derek L: Finance note: discount stacking cap = 25% total. If we attach a HW kicker, marketplace discount should be <= 15%. We need to model renewal uplift to forecast revenue.

Sara P: @Miguel can you own the SKU matrix? Need mapping: marketplace SKU -> appliance SKU -> entitlement code + seat/throughput buckets.

Miguel R: Will do. Draft matrix as a gist and share by EOD: https://gist.github.com/example/sku-map (placeholder). I'll ping Nimbus PM for hardware SKUs.

MarketplaceBot: MarketplaceBot: Draft private offer created: PO-9021 for tenant 'nimbus-test' (expires 2026-05-01).

Anjali K: We also need co-announcement timing. Legal wants final assets 5 business days before announce. Proposed co-announce date: 2026-05-15.

Derek L: If we announce 2026-05-15, recommend reserve commit window: 2026-05-15 -> 2026-06-30, with first invoice/activation 2026-07-01. That aligns with quarter accounting and gives ops time to provision.

Sara P: Decision proposal: lock co-announce 2026-05-15; early-bird window 2026-05-01 -> 2026-05-14; general offer 2026-05-15 -> 2026-06-30. Action items: @Anjali draft customer email + PR blurb, @Miguel finalize SKU map, @Derek confirm discount caps and accounting tags in MSA.

Miguel R: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate SKU mapping and post updates here. :+1:

Anjali K: I'll adapt the marketing template: "Private Offer — Redwood + Nimbus Appliance" and share in #marketing once internal sign-off done.

Sara P: Scheduling a 30-min sync Thurs 9am PT. Agenda: review SKU matrix, legal checklist, approve final offer JSON + rollout plan.

Sara P: Example offer JSON (for legal/ops reference):
```
{
  "offer_id": "PO-9021",
  "partner": "Nimbus",
  "sku_map": [
    {"marketplace_sku": "rw-mp-appl-100", "appliance_sku": "nimbus-appl-1", "entitlement_code": "ENT-APPL-100"}
  ],
  "discount": "15%",
  "start_date": "2026-05-15",
  "end_date": "2026-06-30",
  "early_bird": {"start": "2026-05-01", "end": "2026-05-14"},
  "stacking_limit": "25%",
  "renewal_policy": "opt-in"
}
```

Miguel R: One more tracking question: renewal opt-in vs auto-renew — legal prefers opt-in for appliance promos. I'll escalate if Nimbus pushes auto.

Derek L: Confirming opt-in from finance side too. Also request: add accounting tag `committed_hw_offer` so revenue is segmented for forecasting.

Sara P: Great. I'll send the invite and attach the draft legal checklist + offer JSON before the sync. Thanks all — we'll finalize at the meeting. :wave:
